listen_address.description: IP address the server listens on (e.g., '127.0.0.1', '::', or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces)

port.description: TCP port to listen on for HTTP traffic

default_files.description: List of filenames to try as index files when a directory is requested

max_body_size.description: Maximum allowed size of HTTP request body in bytes (0 = no limit)

directory_listing.description: Whether to show directory listings when no index file exists

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS/SSL encryption for HTTPS traffic

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format)

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file (PEM format)

root.description: Document root for this virtual host

index_files.description: Index filenames to try for this host (optional)

ssl_cert.description: Per-host SSL certificate path (optional, overrides global)

ssl_key.description: Per-host SSL private key path (optional, overrides global)

mime_types.description: Map of file extensions (without dot) to MIME types

access_log.description: Path to access log file (empty string disables logging)

error_log.description: Path to error log file (empty string disables logging)
